reason: Esc closes the Delete Test Person dialog and focus lands on body. Go back does the same, because the detail panel closes with the dialog and its Delete button leaves the DOM. The next Tab goes to the page-end buttons and then wraps, and the first catalog row is about 52 tab stops from the page start, so keyboard users lose their place. The dialog is unnamed (probe) and Go back and Delete item are reachable by Tab, so this is not high.
